items: Material and Washing Care - The womens summer casual short sets are made of 100% COTTON. Stretch - Non, Thickness - Thin. Machine wash cold with like colors in laundry bag. Don’t bleach. Hang to dry.

Features - The women summer short sets travel outfits are designed with striped/checkered short sets, casual crewneck sleeveless tank tops and shorts with adjustable drawstring, 2 slash pockets.The side hidden zipper design makes it easy to wear.

Loose Fit - This outfit shorts sets for women can be worn with a nice necklace and shoes or keep it really casual with sneakers or sandals. It's easy to wear, stylish, and combines both comfort and aesthetics.
Occasions - The two piece tank & shorts outfits are suitable for spring and summer, daily, office, work, street, home, travel, and beach vacation.
Size - S=US(4-6), M=US(8-10), L=US(12-14), XL=US(16-18), XXL=US(20-22). More details in the rich description for the summer 2 piece sets for women.
